protocol: recto.evaluate crops and fields (seed 2000 + push); a node keeps its position unless |offset| >= Z * predicted Laplace scale; it2 = second pass read at the corrected surface; crops predicted whole, no smoothing, no clipping
rule: per model, Z = smallest of [0.0, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0] with one-pass within-1 share at rest >= 0.85 on PHerc0814

Paris4_val.role: validation: r2 checkpoint and r2/r3 choice

PHerc0814.role: validation: r2/r3 choice; the Z rule

Paris4_test.role: held-out test band (r3 is its second look)

PHerc0139.role: cross-scan test for r2; training scan for r3 (not held out)
